These special conditions should be read and construed along with general conditions- 1- Scope of Work: - The scope of services to be provided by “WORK OF TESTING OF DIFFERENT LEVL CIRCUIT BREAKER AT VARIOUS 220KV /132KV SUBSTATION UNDER ELECTRICITY TRANSMISSION DIVISION SAMBHAL “and also as detailed out in schedule of Work.

2- T & P:- All T & P required for proper execution of works shall be arranged by the contractor himself, at his own cost. 3- LABOUR: - Skilled labour for said work shall be arranged by the contractor at his own cost. In this connection department does not take any responsibility. However, person deployed by the contractor found including in the act of union, indiscipline or anything objectionable, shall be removed from site if asked to do so by engineer. 4- ELECTRICITY RULE: - All construction work shall be carried out as per relevant provision of Indian Electricity Rule 1956 and Indian Electricity Act. 1910 or any amendment there of. Technical specification of the contract and any other manual referred to therein shall be strictly adhered to. 5- SAFETY & WORKMANSHIP : - All safety rules shall be strictly observed by the contractor during the entire period of execution of work. However in case of any major or minor accident, the contractor shall be wholly responsible for all consequences arising thereof including payment of compensation under ‘Workers’ compensation Act and the department shall in no way be responsible of this. JE & AE shall ensure that at no level the safety ruled are violated. 6- MATERIAL:- All required material for shall be provided by Contractor as per work scope document . 7- THEFT & LOSSES : - In case of any theft and losses of material, reported by security guard/Contractor, necessary FIR shall be lodged by concerned JE with the concerning Police Station. 8- INSURANCE: - The responsibility to maintain adequate insurance coverage at all times during period of contract for safety of staff deployed and spares handed over for maintenance shall be that of contractor. The contractor shall also take necessary insurance to indemnity third party risk arising out of work to be done by him at his own cost. The department shall not be responsible in any way in case of any mishappening. The contractor shall provide with copy of all insurance policies & documents to Executive Engineer. 9- SUPERVISION: - All work shall be supervised by Assistant Engineer / JE shall be over all in charge of supervision of each & every work in the contract. JE entrusted to get the work done, shall personally ensures that the execution is done exclusively as per specification of contract. In case of any deviation he will immediately write to contractor under intimation to Assistant Engineer/ Engineer in Charge. 10- ENGINEER: - Executive Engineer, Electricity Transmission Division Sambhal, UPPTCL, shall be Engineer of the contract. 11- VERIFICATION OF BILLS : - After the work has been satisfactorily completed the work Contractor will submitted bill to concerned JE/AE for recording in MB and verification. Any delay beyond that shall have to be justified by JE&AE in the covering letter. There should not be any

substantial gap between the date of verification of bills in MB and its submission in the office of EE. 12- DISPUTE: - In case of any dispute in respect of interpretation of any provision in the contract of any nature in respect of the work, the decision of the superintending engineer, Electy. Trans. circle, UPPTCL, Moradabad shall be final & binding upon both the parties. 13- JURISDICTION OF COURT: - The contract shall be governed by the Law of Government of India for the time in force in District Moradabad in the state of U.P. and shall be under the jurisdiction of Hon’ble High Court, Allahabad. No other court shall have jurisdiction to entertain the same. 14- PENALTY: - The Contractor shall have to executive execute the above work within stipulated time allowed, failing which a penalty @ ½% per week on remaining work subject to maximum of 10% of amount of the work shall be levied and recovered from the contractor’s bills. Partial completion of work not allowed and this is assumed as 100 % work incomplete. 15- FINANCIAL CONDITIONS : - (a)- PRICE: - To be quoted on rate schedule enclosed. (b)- DAMAGE OF EQUIPMENT :- The contractor shall ensure to follow all instructions issued by concerned AE/JE. Incase damage of any equipment, if it is found due to negligence of contractor’s employee/labour, same shall be recovered from contractor’s bill. (c)- VARIATION:- The quantities are estimated and may vary +/- 10%. 16- STATUTORY DUTIES AND TAXES :- (a)- LOCAL TAXES AND LEVIES :- All such taxes if levied shall be born by the contractor & deemed to be included in rates quoted. (b)- INCOME TAX: - The contractor shall be liable and responsible for payment of such taxes if attracted under the provision of law. ((c)- G.S.T. : - G.S.T., as applicable as per provision of the laws shall be paid by the department. (d)- LABOUR CESS :- Labour Cess at prevailing rates shall be, as actual & as per current labour rules. 17. Documents to be Submit:- 1. The tenderer shall submit copy of latest Income Tax clearance certificate/Return filed and PAN Card. 2. The tenderer shall submit copy of GST Registration/relevant GST document certificate. 3- The Firm should have experience of “Tan-Delta Testing of Power T/F ” at 220 KV and above sub-stations in UPPTCL / Govt. Transmission Utility. Experience as Sub contractor shall not be considered. (Attach the copy of agreement/ work performance certificate). 4. The tenderer must be registered with Labour Department, In reference to UPPCL order

No.-180/Tr. Anu-04B/UPPTCL Dt-09/05/2025] the contractor have to insured his labour and worker amounting to Rs. 7.50 Lac each which will be deployed for work and should have WC policy. 5. The tenderer must be registered with ESI Department of UP Government. 6. The tenderer must be registered with EPF (Employee Provident Fund) of UP govt.. And Latest UDYAM Reg. registration certificate with related category NIC code. 7. The Tenderer must be submitted as affidavit that they have never been black listed ( on 100 Rs Stamp paper). 08. The tenderer must be registered with Directorate of Electrical Safety of UP Government as “A” Class electrical contractor. IN CASE of renewal of the same, tenderer shall submit copy of renewal fee receipt and application in Part-I, failing which Part-II (Price bid) of the tender shall not be opened. 09. The Tenderer must be submitting Character certificate issued by District Magistrate (DM). Executive Engineer ETD-SAMBHAL .
